varieties.name: Rosecoco (GLP-2)
varieties.supplier_notes: Market favourite: large speckled seed, top prices.

varieties.name: Mwitemania (GLP-X92)
varieties.supplier_notes: Round, faster-cooking; good in mixed stands.

varieties.name: KAT B1
varieties.supplier_notes: Biofortified (iron + zinc); institutional and school-feeding demand.

timeline_template.description_en: Beans follow maize in rotation — they fix nitrogen, so no heavy manure needed.
timeline_template.description_sw: Maharagwe hufuata mahindi kwa zamu — yanatengeneza nitrojeni, haihitaji samadi nyingi.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant 25-30 kg per acre at 45cm × 10-15cm, 2-5 cm deep, at the first reliable rain.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda kilo 25-30 kwa eka kwa 45cm × 10-15cm, kina cha cm 2-5, kwa mvua za kwanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Band 50 kg DAP per acre. Skip nitrogen top-dress entirely — it feeds weeds, not pods.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za DAP. Usiweke CAN kabisa — inalisha magugu, si maganda.

timeline_template.description_en: First weeding — beans are poor competitors in their first month.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwanza — maharagwe hushindwa na magugu mwezi wa kwanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout bean fly in the seedling stage and angular leaf spot from flowering. Treat early — late treatment rarely pays.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza nzi wa maharagwe kwenye miche na madoa ya majani kuanzia maua. Tibu mapema.

timeline_template.description_en: Pull when pods turn yellow-brown and ~80% are dry — don't wait for full dry-down in the field.
timeline_template.description_sw: Ng'oa wakati maganda yamegeuka manjano na ~80% yamekauka — usisubiri yakauke kabisa shambani.
timeline_template.tip_en: Thresh within a week, sun-dry to 13%, and store in hermetic bags against bruchids.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Pukuchua ndani ya wiki, kausha hadi 13%, hifadhi kwa magunia maalum dhidi ya wadudu wa ghala.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade by seed size, colour uniformity, and cleanliness. Reject mouldy or shrivelled seed.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 90 kg bags; hermetic bags for storage against bruchid weevils.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sun-dry to 13%, seal in hermetic bags — oxygen depletion kills bruchids without chemicals.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Kausha hadi 13%, funga magunia maalum — ukosefu wa hewa unaua wadudu bila dawa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Seedling death, maggot tunnels at stem base, yellowing and stunting.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kifo cha miche, vichuguu vya viluwiluwi chini ya shina, kuwitikia.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered seed-dressing insecticide; early foliar only in the seedling stage. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa ya mbegu iliyoidhinishwa; nyunyuza mapema tu kipindi cha miche. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Plant early and dense so the stand outgrows it.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the stem base — leaf photos miss the tunnel.

diseases.symptoms_en: Brown angular lesions with grey centres on leaves and pods, worst in wet weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye katikati ya kijivu, zaidi mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered contact/systemic fungicide classes at first lesions. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha, mbegu safi, nafasi ya kutosha.
diseases.scanner_notes: Angular vein-bounded shape discriminates vs anthracnose.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark lesions on pods, stems and cotyledons; black seed blotches.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye maganda na mashina; madoa meusi kwenye mbegu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered fungicide at first sign; never save seed from an infected crop. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa mara inapoanza; usihifadhi mbegu za shamba lililoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Seed-borne — the seed-source question in-app improves the advice.

diseases.symptoms_en: Orange-brown pustules on undersides, yellow halo, defoliation in humid spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viputo vya rangi ya kutu chini ya majani, mpaka wa manjano, majani huanguka.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered rust-active fungicide at onset. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya kutu mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Aina sugu (Nyota), epuka kumwagilia kutoka juu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Pustules rub off on fingers — the field test that confirms rust.

diseases.symptoms_en: Dark rotting roots, stunted yellow patches, plants pull out easily.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mizizi inayooza, mapande ya manjano, mimea hung'oleka kwa urahisi.
diseases.treatment_en: No effective spray — drainage is the fix. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna dawa mwafaka — mifereji ndio tiba. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Raised beds, rotation, avoid waterlogged fields.
diseases.prevention_sw: Vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, zungusha, epuka maeneo ya maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph an uprooted plant with roots washed.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Bean prices peak in the lean months (Nov–Dec, Mar–May). The farmer who stored well sells at the top; selling at harvest leaves 20–30% on the table.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Bei ya maharagwe hupanda miezi ya uhaba (Nov–Des, Mar–Mei). Aliyetunza vizuri anauza bei ya juu; kuuza wakati wa mavuno kunapoteza 20–30%.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 6,000–10,000 KES per 90 kg bag (November 2026) — often double maize per kilo. Input bill under 8,000 KES per acre.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 6,000–10,000 kwa gunia la kilo 90 (Novemba 2026) — mara nyingi mara mbili ya mahindi kwa kilo. Gharama chini ya 8,000 KES kwa eka.
